title: Build Your Team with Claude: 36 free skills, 6 departments
instagram:
Your next 6 hires are Claude skills. 🤖

❌ No recruiting.
❌ No onboarding.
✅ 36 free skills, 6 departments.

Here is the team:

1️⃣ Developers: Superpowers
Claude plans, tests first and reviews before it ships.

2️⃣ Designers: UI UX Pro Max
Styles, palettes and UX rules for cleaner UI.

3️⃣ Marketing: Copywriting
Landing and pricing page copy that sounds human.

4️⃣ Finance: Reconciliation
GL vs bank statements, breaks flagged.

5️⃣ Small Business: Cash Flow Snapshot
A 30/60/90-day cash forecast from your ledger or a CSV.

6️⃣ Legal: Contract Review
Clause-by-clause review against your playbook, with redlines.

+5 more per department in the guide. 36 in total, all on GitHub.

How to install:
Copy a skill folder (with its SKILL.md) into ~/.claude/skills/. Claude Code picks it up live, no restart. Or run the /plugin install line on each page.

The bottom line: you do not need 36 people to start. You need the right skill per job, and a human who signs off on the finance and legal work.
